subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. **

Collaboration
solution:
The correct answer is Division.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Collaboration means the act of working together, especially on a goal or shared project. (सहयोग)

 -Example: Online education can be an environment for collaboration and intellectual amplification.

 
• Marked option Division means the separation of something into different parts; the sharing of something between different people, groups, places, etc. (विभाजन)

 -Example: There is a growing economic division between the north and south of the country.

 
• So it is clear that Collaboration and Division are opposite in meaning.

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__**Partnership**__ means a formal arrangement by two or more parties to manage and operate a business and share its profits. (**साझेदारी**)

__**Participation**__ means the act of joining with others in doing something. (**भाग लेना**)

__**Association**__ means joining or working with another person or group (**संगठन**)
